overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals accepted withdrawals for commercial and Chapter 40B development petitions, denied a fence variance on Winford Way, and approved dimensional relief for projects on Sydney Street and Forest Street.

items.title: 360 Salem Street
items.summary: The board voted to accept the applicant's request to withdraw without prejudice a special permit petition to convert a commercial condominium into a medical office.

items.title: 280 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: The board voted to accept the applicant's request to withdraw a Chapter 40B comprehensive permit petition for a 378-unit multi-family apartment development.

items.title: 28 Winford Way
items.summary: Following testimony from the builder and opposing neighbors regarding fence height and lack of prior communication, the board voted to deny a variance for an over-height fence.

items.title: 65 Sydney Street
items.summary: The board voted to approve a side yard setback variance allowing a storage shed under 200 square feet to remain on the property.

items.title: 160 Forest Street
items.summary: The board approved a variance for a six-foot fence enclosed around a pool on a corner lot and granted a special permit waiving the corner visibility requirement.
